prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create one minimalist clean white contour exercise drawing on a genuinely transparent background. Only thin white SINGLE strokes, NO filled areas. Large interiors of body and clothing are empty transparent. Absolutely no shading, no stippling, no speckles, no texture, no solid white patches or gray/black filled shapes.
Subject: one adult woman with tied-back hair, plain sports top and shorts, barefoot. Full-body static wall-supported ankle-over-knee stretch. She lies face-up on floor, back/head/pelvis supported. Head at lower left, legs toward upper right. One supporting leg bent, bare sole visibly flat on a vertical wall at right. The other ankle rests across the supporting thigh immediately above the opposite kneecap, with that hip opened outward and crossed foot away from wall. BOTH arms lie alongside her body, with palms down, visible and separate from trunk. No hand holds a leg.
Camera: elevated three-quarter oblique side view, showing crossed ankle resting above supporting knee and sole-wall contact clearly. Full body uncropped within square canvas, natural adult proportions. Sparse thin white lines indicate vertical wall and floor junction. One held pose.
Clean simple medical contour illustration; simple face, a few anatomical creases only. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, two feet. No text, no arrows, no labels, no numeric angles, no motion, no alternate poses, no equipment other than outlined wall/floor, no pillow, bench, mat or room details. Transparent canvas and body interiors.
